# Noctua NA-FG1-20 200 mm fan grill

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

| | |

| Category | purchased |
| Product | <https://www.noctua.at/en/products/na-fg1-20-sx5> |

Steel wire grill with round struts and an offset centre for 200 mm fans. Sold as
NA-FG1-20 Sx2 (2 grills, 8 fan screws, 8 push-pins) and NA-FG1-20 Sx5 (5 grills,
20 fan screws, 20 push-pins). The push-pins hold the grill 5 mm off the fan, which
Noctua says lowers the airflow and noise penalty; they can be cut shorter.
The datasheet gives package sizes only: the grill's outer size, wire depth, hole
pattern and mass are not published. Noctua lists it for 200 mm fans, which implies
the NF-A20's 154 mm pattern; confirm on the grill before relying on it.
